soundness_flags.label: def:global-fiber and all downstream fiber statements
soundness_flags.one_line: Phi_eta(P) is a quotient by S_2, but I(P) and several statements quantify psi in Phi_eta(P) and apply tau to it without defining the induced quotient map or choosing representatives.

soundness_flags.label: ass:branch-continuity / thm:hausdorff-consistency
soundness_flags.one_line: BC(P) asserts Gamma_c(P') equals g_c(P',K_c) although Gamma_c consists of (R,v) chart coordinates while g_c is declared Theta_eta-valued; its ambient coordinate space must be corrected before the condition has a determinate meaning.

soundness_flags.label: thm:regular-reduction, final sentence
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed singleton criterion compares only two relative permutations but, outside the regular intersection, does not quantify over all within-arm collision-fiber representations that can also change the ATT.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:hausdorff-consistency
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Branch continuity is maintained rather than derived from the primitive compact model.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Hausdorff and ordered-endpoint consistency are claimed only for P in the corrected branch-continuity class; whole-set coverage remains the unconditional compact-model inference claim.

source_verification_receipts.locator: PDF pp. 15–17, Assumptions TI-LT/CS-LT/RSM and Propositions 4–5 with Corollary 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CS-LT bounds treatment assignment conditional on latent type and untreated history; Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and ATT under RSM, M, TI-LT, and ID, while the text describes ID as imposing nonsingularity regularity.
The paper gives a birational parametrization and semialgebraic membership test for binary HMMs; vanishing denominators reduce membership to lower-dimensional submodels.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 2024
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published method reduces discrete causal questions to polynomial programming, uses dual relaxation and spatial branch-and-bound, and explicitly notes that sharp identified regions can be disconnected.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the quotient-induced ATT map explicitly, rewrite all fiber quantifiers over representatives or equivalence classes consistently, and repair BC so its maps land in the lifted chart-coordinate space.

Sharpen the regular-reduction statement to the regular intersection, or add an explicit all-chart quantifier to the permutation criterion; then prove the benchmark witnesses exercise that repaired criterion.

Turn the remaining-atlas OEQ into a second completed singular stratum with a compact observable certificate and a worked rational law, so the field contribution is not carried chiefly by an open completion.

recommended_next_step: Revise the quotient, branch-continuity, and regular-fiber formulations; retain the singular coupled-arm atlas as a field-tier novelty candidate after those semantic repairs.
